title: Scarcity
equation: Scarcity Pull = (Genuine Limit + Visibility + Time Pressure) ÷ 3
hook: Fake countdown timers work right up until someone notices. Then your brand pays for it.
statement: Things feel more valuable when they're rare or limited, but only when the limit is real.
explainer: Real limits drive action: a capped cohort, an actual deadline, limited founding spots. Saying 8 spots left on an unlimited webinar gets caught, and it costs more trust than it ever earned.
sop: Find the real limits you have: capacity, deadline, or stock.
Make the deadline easy to see.
Stick to the deadline, no extensions.
Never invent scarcity that isn't there.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Genuine Limit 9, Visibility 6, Time Pressure 5. (9 + 6 + 5) ÷ 3 = 6.7. Higher means real urgency that drives action without hurting trust. Lower means the scarcity is invisible or not believable.
question: Name one real limit in your business you could honestly tell customers about.
closing_statement: Urgency only works as long as it's true.
caption:
Principle Nº 304: Scarcity

Fake countdown timers work right up until someone notices. Then your brand pays for it.

Things feel more valuable when they're rare or limited, but only when the limit is real.
